title: LOOK: OTS conducts security inspection at PITX ahead of Undas 2026

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—The Office for Transportation Security (OTS) conducted a security check at the Parañaque Integrated Terminal Exchange (PITX) on Thursday, Oct. 29, in anticipation of the influx of passengers for Undas 2026. During the inspection, OTS officials did a walk-through, checked in on the security personnel on standby, and distributed emergency go bags to some passengers at Gate 4 who were awaiting boarding. OTS Administrative and Finance Service Director Ernesto Tendero discussed the contents of the kit and demonstrated how to inflate the go bags to turn it into a floater in case of emergency.
